title: Say Milagro na Ag-inmesel a Paneknek
intro: Nabet mo so sakey a pigura ya asakbongan na istorya na madibinon impibiang. Sakey a salaysay nipaakar ed mamilagron probisyon tan sakey ya agmakasalitan depensa ya onlelesa ed panaon. Naamtaan mo kasi no siopa ray akaarap ed sayan ekstraordinaryon subok?
clues: Akaawat ak na madibinon mensahe ya amabigla ed siak
Kinuwestiyon na totook so kalinisan ko nen pinmawil ak ya walay anak ko
Ingganggan ak ya manayunal ya ag mansalita ed loob na sakey a panaon
Sakey a subol na danum tan petsa so amabiskeg ed siak legan na bista ko
Say Katawan ko et nanggawa na mamilagron kiew ya yegyeg pian naitdan to ak
Pinmayawar ed siak so sakey ya anghel ya akanengneng ed nengneng na ayadyarin too

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Mananak ya bukor ed silong na kiew a palma
Say pangibantak ed manliob ya abot
Manbabatik ed sakey a mapangtan manuley
trial.answer: Mananak ya bukor ed silong na kiew a palma

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Apaneknekan so inka-inosente ko nen nansalita so ugaw nin anak kon laki
Saray totook et aderal lapud dusa na Dios
Inwanwan ko so bansak ed pananalo
Sakey a mamilagron bobon so permanentin pinmatnag
outcome.answer: Apaneknekan so inka-inosente ko nen nansalita so ugaw nin anak kon laki

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
